admission.justification: Publishing the found enclosure stage before seat copies prevents active seats from working under a planning document and stale master row.

applicability: role_start, role_start_set and dashboard start for worker/reviewer/curator finding an existing enclosure. Created enclosures retain worktree_start behavior.
conditions: Enclosure preparation answered found and its cleanup is not abandoned, reopened or completed.
The leaf still reads planning and the intent-review and directory checks already passed.
Publication happens before seat copies are prepared.
exclusions: A newly created enclosure, whose stage move remains worktree_start.
A direct-grant leaf, an abandoned leaf or a leaf already inProgress or later.
statement: An admitted leaf-role start that finds its existing live enclosure moves a planning leaf and its master row to inProgress as the last workspace-resolution act, after intent-review and directory checks and before seat document copies. Terminal/reopened contracts, abandoned or later-stage leaves and direct leaves are unchanged; a binding-write failure refuses by name before any seat exists, and repeated already-current starts write nothing.
